pages.text: A mech has four mounts, one module each. Modules are fitted in a $(l:mech/mech_hangar)Mech Hangar$(/l)'s console while the mech is parked on the pad: the hangar's gantry arm carries each one to its mount. Every module is built around an Advanced Frame.

Their parts stay stowed while the mech stands empty. $(l)When you climb in$(), the jet's wings and the armour come out; the drill and the blade come out when you switch them on, and go back when you switch them off or get out.
$(li)$(item)Mech Jet Module$(): Back, Two wings unfold segment by segment, two nozzles light up, $(l)Flight$(): hold jump in the air to climb, sneak to dive, neither to glide. 120 FE/t in the air

$(li)$(item)Mech Drill Module$(): Right arm, The $(l)R$() key slides a drill out under the hand; it turns while on, Digs twice as fast, $(l)3x3$(), and gets the drops of any tier. 40 FE per extra block

$(li)$(item)Mech Blade Module$(): Left arm, The $(l)G$() key slides a glowing blade out of the forearm, $(l)18$() extra damage a blow and $(l)8$() to everything near the target. 160 FE a blow$(br)$(li)$(item)Mech Armor Module$(): Trunk, Plates close onto the shoulders, chest and thighs, The mech takes $(l)40%$() less damage

The keys are in the controls under $(o)CyberFarm Mech$(). The cockpit display lists every fitted module with its state: the jet READY or THRUST, the drill and blade ON or OFF with their keys, the armour's protection.
